name: flashcard-guru-pages
description: Flashcard Guru marketing site + legal pages, deployed to flashcard-guru.flashify.app via Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public --project-name=flashcard-guru && sleep 5 && scripts/ping-indexnow.sh

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev public --port 8788
